title: Left Hip Prosthetic Joint Infection (Primary Focus)
antibiogram: MDR / ESBL producer; susceptible to Colistin & Tigecycline; resistant to fluoroquinolones, cephalosporins & beta-lactamase inhibitors
description: Persistent sinus tract with active purulent discharge over the lateral left hip surgical scar. Orthopedic hardware biofilm formation with bacterial seeding directly into deep femoral venous tributaries.
clinicalImpact: Continuous bacterial discharge served as the vascular launchpad for secondary systemic bacteremia, seeding both heart valves and systemic circulation.

title: Systemic Vascular Bacteremia & Sepsis Highway
anatomicalSite: Deep Femoral Vein → Inferior Vena Cava → Right Atrium
description: Procalcitonin exploded to 11.16 ng/mL (normal < 0.05 ng/mL, > 220x baseline), CRP reached 88 mg/L, TLC elevated to 18,200/µL with 88% neutrophils.
clinicalImpact: Bacterial endotoxins induced severe hemodynamic instability, vascular leak, profound hypoalbuminemia (1.7 g/dL), and secondary organ seeding.

title: Mitral Valve Infective Endocarditis (1.9 cm Vegetation)
antibiogram: High-risk Cardioembolic Mass (Size: 1.9 cm x 0.8 cm)
description: Large mobile pedunculated vegetation measuring 1.9 cm oscillating on the posterior mitral leaflet with eccentric moderate-to-severe mitral regurgitation (MR) and pulmonary hypertension (PASP 45 mmHg).
clinicalImpact: Mechanical fragmentation of this large vegetation discharged septic emboli directly into systemic arterial circulation (carotid arteries → brain).

title: Bilateral Cardioembolic Multi-Infarct Strokes
anatomicalSite: Brain - Bilateral MCA, PCA & Cerebellar Hemispheres
antibiogram: Acute Cortical / Subcortical Ischemia & Cytotoxic Edema
description: Multiple wedge-shaped non-contiguous cortical and subcortical ischemic infarctions affecting bilateral cerebral hemispheres, manifesting as acute altered mental state, dysphasia, and left-sided hemiparesis.
clinicalImpact: Cerebral hypoperfusion and septic micro-abscess potential, severely impairing neurological and metabolic stability.

title: Terminal Renal Failure (Diabetic CKD G5 + Septic ATN)
description: Nodular diabetic glomerulosclerosis (Kimmelstiel-Wilson nodules), marked interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy (IFTA > 80%). Creatinine peaked at 6.2 mg/dL with Blood Urea 184 mg/dL.
clinicalImpact: Zero renal clearance capacity; complete fluid and metabolic retention; mandatory thrice-weekly maintenance hemodialysis.
